notes: Fakes in this scenario: the fake messaging platform (incl. Feishu token/bot-info responders added here), and DB-inserted org/public/self-product Connections (no product API creates them). Everything else is the real product through its real doors.
hatch CLI has no pricing command: the Product's initial price is set through PUT /v1/creator/products/:id/pricing (the Studio route).

conversation watch --after 0 on finished Runs ends at the FIRST Run's end and carries no reply text (deltas are not replayed); catching up on history is conversation show. Watching a live Run from now returns the full reply.

No hatch command or MCP tool confirms or declines an Assistant task: the confirmation is POST /v1/creator/assistant/tasks/:id/(approve|decline) (Studio web) or an IM button. The coding agent can propose, not confirm.

defects.title: A self Product Connection never answers: the sender gets no reply and no notice, the inbound ends `failed`
defects.expected: Spec: `self` => account principal for a Product too; the owner texting their own Product from a linked chat gets one final reply
defects.actual: The Registry ProductTarget sends a thread-ref to Chat with an account principal; the Runtime's account binder only accepts conversation refs and throws ChatError binding_unavailable 503 ('Account messages are not configured on this Runtime.'). ProductTarget treats only <500/501/'unavailable' as refusals, so the event is retried and ends state=failed after 5 attempts (last_error: Account messages are not configured on this Runtime.). The platform received 0 messages, no Run was created
defects.repro: stack.connection({audience:'self', productId}); stack.admit(sender); POST a Telegram private message from that sender. Code: runtime-server/src/index.ts chatGatewayFor binders.account (ref.kind !== 'conversation' -> unavailable('Account')), channels/productTarget.ts catch

defects.title: hatch CLI and MCP cannot start a Chat conversation with any Product (every Product needs a brief spec; creating without brief_answers is refused)
defects.expected: A coding agent can start a Chat conversation with any published Product (matrix cell Coding agent x Chat). At least a spec with no required field must not need answers
defects.actual:
ask/chat_send create the conversation with only client_request_id. createBriefSnapshot throws 'Brief answers must be an array' (HTTP 422 brief_answer_invalid) when brief_answers is missing, even for a spec whose only field is required:false (CLI exit 1: {"error":{"code":"brief_answer_invalid","message":"Request failed (422): Brief answers must be an array","status":422}}
). With a required field the same door needs an answer the CLI/MCP has no flag/argument to supply (CLI exit 1). HTTP works with brief_answers: [] (optional) or a real answer (required). Products without a brief spec are refused by Chat itself (403 Forbidden: product.brief_spec: A Product requires a BriefSpec), so no Product is reachable by 'hatch ask' / chat_send as a first message; only --conversation/conversation_id on a conversation the HTTP door started works.
defects.repro: Publish a Product with brief_spec.fields=[{id:'goal',label:'g',required:false}]; `hatch ask hi --product <id> --wait` -> 422 brief_answer_invalid; same for MCP chat_send. Root: runtime-server/src/brief.ts createBriefSnapshot (array check) called from index.ts POST /v1/conversations; packages/hatch-cli/src/chatCommands.js startConversation sends no brief_answers

defects.title: A public Connection cannot be reached on Telegram: an unknown sender is told to connect from Studio
defects.expected: Spec: `public` takes anyone as a contact (router: 'public takes anyone'). A public Product Connection answers any Telegram user
defects.actual: With a public Connection for the Product, an unknown sender got: ["请先从 Hatch Studio 连接 Telegram。"]. resolveConnection returns undefined for an unknown sender when the tenant scope is empty (the shared Telegram bot), so the router never reaches meet(); only own-app tenants (scope = account id, Feishu/Lark/WeCom) can meet public contacts, and no code path (deep link, link code) binds a public Connection on a shared bot
defects.repro: stack.connection({audience:'public', productId}); POST a Telegram private message from a never-seen sender id
